target: ADR + narrowly-scoped exemption from DCP-RED-MERGE-SEAM-0001 for exactly two workflow files (.github/workflows/pr-steward.yml, .github/workflows/embedded-audit.yml), so their already-reviewed, already-tested inline-Python-to-module extractions (TP-DMX-AUDIT-STEWARD-CONTRACT-HYGIENE-001 Slices 2/3) can be wired in.
background: src/dopemux/dcp/red_lane_rules.py FORBIDDEN_PATHS contains the pattern ^\.github/workflows/.*$, hard-blocking Edit/Write/NotebookEdit on every workflow file (enforced by .claude/hooks/dcp_surface_guard.py, PreToolUse).

This is broader than the seam's own stated purpose in docs/03-reference/dcp/README.md, which describes DCP-RED-MERGE-SEAM-0001 as forbidding import/call/wrap/wire of src/dopemux_pr_merge_specialist/queue_drain.py (execute=True) and scripts/batch_resolve_and_merge.py — not a blanket ban on editing CI workflow YAML.

TP-DMX-AUDIT-STEWARD-CONTRACT-HYGIENE-001 Slice 2 (tools/pr_steward/workflow_run_identity.py, extracted + unit-tested at commit 94f368b8c on branch worktree-pr-steward-security-approval-parity, then reverted at 123f1b8b8 per this hard block) and Slice 3 (test-only diagnostic-proof parity coverage in tests/audit/test_run_embedded_audit.py, landed without a workflow edit) are both blocked or working around the gap this packet is meant to close cleanly.
invariants: Scope is exactly two paths: .github/workflows/pr-steward.yml and .github/workflows/embedded-audit.yml. No other .github/workflows/* file is exempted.

The exemption must be additive and narrow (e.g. a new ALLOWED_WORKFLOW_EDITS allowlist checked before the existing forbidden-path match, or two explicit negative-lookahead carve-outs in the pattern) — it must NOT remove or weaken the ^\.github/workflows/.*$ rule for any other workflow file.
DCP-RED-MERGE-SEAM-0001's actual merge-seam prohibition (queue_drain.py execute=True, batch_resolve_and_merge.py) is untouched by this packet.
No permission expansion: this packet does not add, broaden, or request new GitHub Actions permissions blocks in either workflow.
No merge automation: this packet does not introduce or enable any automatic PR merge, auto-approval, or merge-queue trigger in either workflow.
No release automation: this packet does not introduce or enable any release/publish/tag/deploy step in either workflow.

No broad weakening of DCP-RED-MERGE-SEAM-0001: the sync test asserting _FALLBACK_FORBIDDEN ⊆ red_lane_rules.FORBIDDEN_PATHS (mentioned in .claude/hooks/dcp_surface_guard.py) must still pass, and the merge-seam TEXT_RULES (queue_drain / batch_resolve_and_merge / gh pr merge / gh api / gh pr review / gh pr comment / gh pr edit pattern scan) remain fully enforced against both workflow files' content.

An ADR documenting the narrowed exemption's rationale, scope, and expiry/review condition (if any) is required before red_lane_rules.py is touched — this packet authors that ADR as its first step, not as an afterthought.
auditor != implementer for this packet, consistent with the repo's standing PAL-chain / role-separation doctrine.
does_not_authorize: New or broadened GITHUB_TOKEN / secrets permissions in either workflow
Removal of the ^\.github/workflows/.*$ rule itself (only a scoped carve-out is authorized)
